query: 结社自由与集体谈判 结社自由与集体谈判 衡量企业保障员工自愿组建、加入工会等组织，并以此与雇主进行有关薪酬、福利、工作条件等事项集体协商权利的程度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：发布了明确的结社自由声明，包含“禁止打压/歧视工会代表”的专项条款；具备完善的集体谈判争议处理流程；披露了具体的集体合同关键条款及审议机制。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的政策承诺，具备工会或职工代表大会（职代会）组织，但缺乏深度的禁止打压机制说明或具体的集体协商争议解决程序。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视沟通”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：相关政策及集体合同覆盖 >80% 的员工或经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在国内主体执行而未覆盖海外子公司，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 结社自由 集体谈判 工会 集体合同 职工代表大会 劳资协商 禁止打压工会代表 集体协商 freedom of association collective bargaining trade union collective agreement works council labour-management negotiation non-retaliation against union representatives 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '结社自由与集体谈判'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工活动或文体协会；仅有“重视沟通”表述；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有申诉热线而无结社/集体谈判内容；区分：本指标关注结社自由与集体谈判权利；员工申诉机制是个体投诉渠道；童工/强迫劳动政策是人权底线禁令，不能替代集体谈判披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group offers a comprehensive remuneration package to employees with reasonable terms. The Group conducts performance review according to the Regulations on Employee Performance Review, and promotes employees based on their working performance. The review also enables management to assess what employees have accomplished and provides recommendations on how to achieve career goals. The Group has formulated the Employee Promotion Management System to govern the promotion criteria and procedures, and to encourage employees to enhance their capabilities.

results.section: Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery
results.text: The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery

[Content]
The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.
